definitionZh: 右侧CSS财产参与指定定位元素的横向位置. 这种内置属性对非定位元素没有影响.
sourceDefinition: The right CSS property participates in specifying the horizontal position of a positioned element. This inset properties has no effect on non-positioned elements.
